text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан has won the autumn Tenno
Sho.
Having surpassed Огури Кэп, our
next goal is the
second race of the
Senior Autumn Triple
Crown—the Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Around the same time, word of Symboli
Rudolf
joining the Japan Cup spreads.
No doubt, she's
planning to engage
Нарита Брайан head on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At last, Нарита Брайан will be able to race
the
Emperor... She is so filled with
determination that
she can only quietly
utter "I want to win."
text_block_list.name: Монолог
